questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: In a residential school in Pune, there are 16 students in a hostel wing. The warden defines a relation F on the set of students: aFb if student a and student b are in the same House (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow). The four Houses partition the 16 students. Is the relation F reflexive?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: In a Government Higher Secondary School in Chennai, the student attendance register for Class 12-A has 5 students. The class teacher defines a relation R on the set of students where a student X is related to student Y if X and Y were present on the same number of days in the month of August 2025.  Is the relation R transitive?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: In a CBSE school in Bangalore, Class 12 students wrote a Mathematics test. Let A be the set of all students. Let R be defined on A as: aRb if student a scored strictly more marks than student b. Let I_A be the identity relation on A. Let E be the empty relation on A. What is the identity relation I_A?

options.text: I_A = {(a,a) for all a in A}
